cnn_resident_grads.notes: G3 (ideas-all-gaps-20261011): x_cnn_idn_flags bit 7 turns on resident glue: conv weights auto-pinned, dW/db and BN running/aux resident (lazy host reads), adaptive pools take DeviceTensors with a cached pool layer, unfilled outputs. Same entries and operands. Workloads: neural resnet-block, conv2d, conv1d, global-maxpool, global-avgpool, maxpool1d, avgpool2d, batchnorm2d, batchnorm1d synthetic; nv+amd.

gpool_warp.notes: G6: window = plane pools (global max/avg) run one 32-thread block per (n, c): strided lane folds then a fixed shared-memory pairwise tree (no shuffles, same on 32/64-wide). Max bits unchanged (associative pick reproduces the serial winner); avg bits change (tree sum), same on NV, AMD and host twin. Needs ID check nv+amd. Workloads: neural global-maxpool, global-avgpool synthetic.
